why.uz: 1-qism u nega ishonchli koʻrinishini aytadi; «however» buradi: u u yerda boʻlmagan, «faktlari» yolgʻon. Ishonch, keyin u ishonchsiz ekani ochiladi.
why.ru: Часть 1: почему он кажется надёжным; «however» поворачивает: его там не было, его «факты» ложны. Доверие, затем раскрытие, что верить ему нельзя.

stem.en:
Learning to type quickly is often presented as a simple matter of hours: the more you practice, the faster you get. The typing club at Asal's school found that this was only partly true. Members who practiced in long, tiring sessions improved little after the first month, while those who practiced for fifteen focused minutes a day kept getting faster.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?

options.en: To show that a common view of practice needs a qualification
To prove that practice of any kind does not improve typing speed
To describe the rules of a school typing club
To explain how typing was taught before computers

why.en: 'Only partly true': short, focused practice kept working, long tiring sessions did not. The text qualifies the view; it never says practice does not help.
why.uz: «Only partly true»: qisqa, diqqatli mashq ish berdi, uzoq va charchatuvchi mashq esa yoʻq. Matn fikrni cheklaydi, mashq foydasiz demaydi.
why.ru: «Only partly true»: короткие сосредоточенные занятия помогали, долгие изнурительные — нет. Текст уточняет мнение, а не отрицает пользу практики.

stem.en:
The drinking fountains at Bekzod's school are old, and many students now bring plastic bottles of water instead. Teachers have proposed installing a filtered water station where students could refill their own bottles. Some parents object that a single station would create long lines at break time, and they suggest smaller stations on every floor instead.

Which choice best describes the overall structure of the text?

options.en: It describes a situation, presents a proposal to address it, and then reports an objection along with an alternative.
It describes a situation, presents a proposal to address it, and then explains why the school finally adopted the proposal.
It explains why plastic bottles are harmful, then argues for banning them.
It compares two kinds of water station, then describes their prices.

why.en: Old fountains (situation), a refill station (proposal), parents fear lines and suggest one per floor (objection and alternative). Nothing says it was adopted.
why.uz: Eski favvoralar (vaziyat), suv toʻldirish joyi (taklif), ota-onalar navbatdan xavotirda va har qavatga bittadan taklif qiladi (eʼtiroz va muqobil). Qabul qilingani aytilmaydi.
why.ru: Старые фонтанчики (ситуация), станция для бутылок (предложение), родители боятся очередей и предлагают по одной на этаж (возражение и альтернатива). О принятии ни слова.

stem.en:
In most accounts of the founding of the village, the first settlers chose the valley for its fertile soil. A song still sung at weddings there tells a different story: in it, the settlers stop in the valley only because a storm has broken a wheel of their cart, and they stay because their young driver falls in love with the daughter of the man who mends it. Whatever the truth, the song suggests that the villagers have long enjoyed a less heroic version of their past.

Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?

options.en: To present a folk version of a village's origin that differs from the usual account
To prove, by means of an old wedding song, that the usual account of the village's founding is false
To explain why the soil of the valley is fertile
To describe the wedding customs of the village

why.en: The song 'tells a different story', and 'Whatever the truth' means nothing is proved. The text presents a folk version that differs from the usual account.
why.uz: Qoʻshiq «tells a different story», «Whatever the truth» esa hech narsa isbotlanmaganini bildiradi. Matn odatiy hikoyadan farq qiladigan xalq variantini keltiradi.
why.ru: Песня «tells a different story», а «Whatever the truth» значит, что ничего не доказано. Текст приводит народную версию, отличную от обычной.
